0022600100.text: Utah hosts New Orleans in the Jazz's second game of the season, with the Jazz at 0-1 after a road loss and 15th in the West, while the Pelicans are also 0-1 following a home loss and sit 12th in the West. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Jazz lost all three meetings in the 2025-26 season series, most recently a 156-137 defeat in New Orleans on April 7, 2026. Utah will be without Jusuf Nurkic (foot), Tony Bradley (quadriceps), and Trey Alexander (knee), all listed as out.
